skill.summary: Create dynamic web experiences with physical-text layouts using Pretext for precise text measurement and Three.js for interactive 3D rendering and animation.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of pretext-agents-skill.

- Combines Pretext for advanced text measurement with Three.js for dynamic 3D/spatial rendering.
- Supports optional Canvas 2D rendering for fast arcade/game mechanics and text destruction effects.
- Integrates optional React Three Fiber and Yoga/Textura patterns for flexible scene and layout management.
- Provides practical architectural patterns and guidance for creating interactive, viral, and editorial web experiences.
- Includes clear implementation advice and best practices for performance, layout orchestration, and platform selection.
